title: Ship's Manual
summary: Read help pages, make sequences with seq() and :, and name your arguments.
hints: `?seq` opens the help page for `seq()`. `args(seq)` shows just its arguments.
`seq(from = 0, to = 100, by = 25)` counts from 0 to 100 in steps of 25.
`1:7` is shorthand for the whole numbers from 1 to 7: `likert_points <- 1:7`.
